description: This file contains implementation of scan operations optimized for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch, including utility functions for grid dimension calculation, kernel dispatch, and specialized scan implementations with index tracking.

classes.name: MetalShaderLibrary
classes.description: Handles loading and retrieving Metal shader pipeline states.

classes.name: MPSStream
classes.description: Encapsulates a Metal command queue and encoder for GPU operations.

methods.name: get_2d_grid_dims
methods.description: Calculates optimal 2D grid dimensions for dispatching Metal compute kernels based on tensor shape and scan dimension.

methods.name: scan_simple_mps_impl
methods.description: Performs a simple scan operation along a specified dimension using Metal shaders, handling tensor contiguity and kernel dispatching.

methods.name: scan_with_indices_mps_impl
methods.description: Performs scan operations that also track indices (e.g., cummax/cummin) using Metal shaders.
